# timeout

Run a child command with a time limit using the local Wasm build.

## Usage

```sh
MOON_HOME="$HOME/.moon-accounts/cli" moon run --target wasm --release commands/timeout -- 1s printf ok
```

Return the child's status on normal completion, 124 on timeout, 125 on setup failure and 126/127 on launch failure.

## Notes

- This command is local-only and is not available as moonx cli/timeout. Run the example from the repository root.
- Process-group termination, signal selection, --kill-after, --foreground and --preserve-status are unsupported. Durations round up to milliseconds and must fit 0 through 2147483647 ms.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
